_about: Cached run for data/cv_samples/aina.txt, used when no API key is set. Hand-written in the exact LLM output format, not a live model answer. It includes one invented quote (Kubernetes) and one misleading years line (NumPy) so the demo shows the gates working. The app re-checks every quote. Replace with a live run: python -m intake.llm_extract intake/samples/aina.txt intake/samples/aina-extraction.json
